name: Aijiro
source:
[i]"Well, young noblewomen don't typically know much about the going-ons of their divisions..."[/i]

The man assigned to be Yori's aide. While he's somewhat clever and capable, he's prone to saying the wrong things at the wrong time.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/itehari/characters/]Aksys Games[/url]]
